nodes.title: Google Cloud
nodes.description: Google's cloud, centred on BigQuery for analytics and its agent platform for AI.

nodes.title: IBM
nodes.description: IBM's watsonx data, AI and governance products, with integration tools and Confluent streaming.

nodes.title: Independent vendors
nodes.description: Commercial tools from vendors that work across platforms rather than offering a complete platform.

nodes.title: Informatica
nodes.description: An enterprise data management suite for integration, quality, governance, MDM and privacy, now owned by Salesforce.

nodes.title: Microsoft Azure and Fabric
nodes.description: Microsoft's Azure services plus Fabric, its SaaS analytics platform, together with Power BI and Purview.

nodes.title: Open-source ecosystem
nodes.description: Open-source projects and open standards that underpin or complement commercial platforms.

nodes.title: Oracle
nodes.description: Oracle's database-centred data and AI services on Oracle Cloud Infrastructure and other clouds.

nodes.title: Palantir
nodes.description: A platform that models enterprise data as an operational ontology for analytics, applications and AI agents.

nodes.title: SAP
nodes.description: SAP's data and analytics services for data from SAP business applications and other sources.

nodes.title: Snowflake
nodes.description: A multi-cloud SaaS data platform built around a managed SQL engine, with engineering, AI and sharing services on top.

nodes.title: Teradata
nodes.description: An enterprise analytics database and platform for large-scale warehousing, on premises and in the cloud.

nodes.title: BCBS 239
nodes.description: Fourteen principles for how banks aggregate risk data and produce risk reports, in normal times and under stress.

nodes.title: Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS)
nodes.description: An open YAML standard for describing a data contract, covering schema, quality, service levels, roles, pricing and where the data is served.

nodes.title: Open Data Product Standard (ODPS)
nodes.description: An open YAML standard for describing a data product, its input and output ports, management interfaces, team and support.

nodes.title: DAMA-DMBOK 2
nodes.description: The Data Management Body of Knowledge, a reference guide that splits data management into knowledge areas around a central governance function.

nodes.title: Data mesh principles
nodes.description: Four principles for decentralising analytical data ownership to business domains while keeping data interoperable and governed.

nodes.title: CDMC (Cloud Data Management Capabilities)
nodes.description: A framework of fourteen key controls for managing sensitive data in cloud and hybrid environments, with certification for cloud platforms and tools.

nodes.title: DCAM v3
nodes.description: The Data Management Capability Assessment Model, an evidence-based framework for scoring how mature an organisation's data management programme is.

nodes.title: EU AI Act
nodes.description: Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, which sets risk-based rules for placing AI systems and general-purpose AI models on the EU market and using them.

nodes.title: EU Data Act
nodes.description: Regulation (EU) 2023/2854 on fair access to and use of data, covering connected-product data, business-to-government access and switching between cloud services.

nodes.title: DORA (Digital Operational Resilience Act)
nodes.description: Regulation (EU) 2022/2554, which sets ICT risk, incident, resilience testing and third-party requirements for EU financial entities.

nodes.title: GDPR
nodes.description: Regulation (EU) 2016/679, the EU's general law on processing personal data, which sets principles, legal bases, individuals' rights and controller duties.

nodes.title: Google Cloud MLOps levels
nodes.description: Google Cloud's three-level description of how far an organisation has automated the building, training and release of machine learning systems.
aliases: MLOps: Continuous delivery and automation pipelines in machine learning

nodes.title: ISO 8000 (data quality)
nodes.description: A series of international standards on data quality, covering concepts, quality management processes, profiling, rules, master data exchange and sensor data.

nodes.title: ISO/IEC 42001:2023
nodes.description: The international standard for an AI management system, setting requirements for governing AI responsibly within an organisation.

nodes.title: Microsoft MLOps maturity model
nodes.description: A five-level model from Microsoft that describes MLOps maturity across people, model creation, model release and application integration.

nodes.title: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
nodes.description: A voluntary framework for managing AI risk through four functions, Govern, Map, Measure and Manage, broken into categories and subcategories of outcomes.

nodes.title: Read paths for applications
nodes.description: How an application should read data from the platform, or publish data to it, compared by latency, concurrency, freshness, consistency and coupling.

nodes.title: Running a maturity assessment
nodes.description: How to assess maturity with the tracks, from scope and evidence to scoring, gap analysis against use cases, presentation and re-assessment.

nodes.title: Conventions
nodes.description: The frontmatter fields, relationship rules, naming rules and editorial rules every concept follows.

nodes.title: Mapping a use case to capabilities
nodes.description: A practical method for turning a business use case into required capabilities with minimum maturity levels, checking platform fit and recording the result.
